bottleneck: Does a corporate RISK_FROM_CONTROLLER gate omission imply an ecosystem-level absence of hard gates?

strongest_counterexample.event: EU DSA.100121 — TikTok Lite Rewards programme
strongest_counterexample.observation: An external regulator converted a permanent feature-withdrawal commitment and anti-circumvention commitment into a binding decision.
strongest_counterexample.evidence_boundary: This demonstrates gate existence and operation; it does not establish realized addictive harm or a causal welfare effect.

blind_first.observability_confidence: HIGH for formal decision and feature withdrawal; LOW/UNKNOWN for realized harm magnitude

role_swap.invariant: If either party used rewards and interface control to steer repeated engagement under the same causal structure and evidence, the same baseline expected-risk assessment applies.
role_swap.legitimate_causal_difference: The platform controlled interface, reward schedule, deployment scale and relevant risk-assessment duty; an ordinary user did not.

risk_to_controller.quantitative_threshold: AI Act systemic-risk presumption uses a compute threshold; applicability and revisions are separate questions

risk_from_controller.quantitative_threshold: No comparable general numeric threshold for dependency, concentration or switching-cost harm identified

claim_effect.replacement: CORPORATE_GATE_ASYMMETRY != ECOSYSTEM_GATE_ASYMMETRY; measure cross-institution gate topology, coverage and enforcement latency.
claim_effect.safety_success_paradox: HOLD; this case does not test whether technical safety increases adoption, dependency, concentration or switching costs.

evaluator_self_audit.likely_error: Confusing existence of a corporate gate with ecosystem-wide gate absence.
evaluator_self_audit.correction: Add external law/regulator layer before inferring absence.
remaining_unknowns: generalization beyond one jurisdiction and platform

repeated_structure_question.who_gains_strength: External enforcement gains leverage when commitments become binding and anti-circumvention is enforceable.
repeated_structure_question.who_bears_cost: The platform loses a growth/engagement mechanism; users' avoided or realized harm remains unquantified.
repeated_structure_question.role_reversal_note: Power difference is causal and preserved, not treated as identity privilege.

next_decisive_test: Across matched platform launches, compare pre-launch risk assessment, launch/withdrawal timing, regulator intervention and engagement outcomes; freeze coding before revealing jurisdiction or firm identity.
